title: First-order $Γ$-expansion for entropic optimal transport with non-degenerate costs
summary: Entropy-regularized optimal transport (EOT) has become a key tool in optimal transport, providing both theoretical insight and efficient computation via the Sinkhorn algorithm. We study the first-order \(Γ\)-expansion of EOT as the regularization parameter \(\varepsilon\) vanishes, by rewriting EOT as the minimization of a relative entropy with respect to a Gibbs measure \(\gibbs\) associated with the duality gap energy.
